event.title: IndyCar's Freedom 250 Grand Prix Takes Over Washington DC Streets
event.canonical_title: IndyCar's Freedom 250 Grand Prix Takes Over Washington DC Streets
event.summary: The Freedom 250 Grand Prix is set to take place on the streets of Washington, D.C., featuring IndyCar racers reaching speeds of nearly 200 mph. President Donald Trump will officially start the race, marking a unique celebration of American motorsport. The event will see cars racing past iconic landmarks, including the Capitol Building and along Pennsylvania Avenue.

timeline.title: IndyCar Race Debuts in Washington, D.C. with Trump as Grand Marshal
timeline.summary: The first IndyCar race in Washington, D.C., known as the 'Freedom 250' Grand Prix, took place this weekend, featuring cars racing past iconic landmarks at speeds nearing 200 mph. Trump waved the green flag to officially start the event, which is part of the celebrations for America's 250th birthday. The race presented unique challenges due to its unconventional route through the National Mall.
